title: Braided Mechanic's Escape: City to Sky
summary: In a world of harsh factory fumes and underworld enticement, a young mechanic with platinum-and-amber braids navigates treacherous streets. She sifts through paperwork, a modicum of loyalty guiding her through the vagary of rampant chaos. A blast signals an overplay of power, foreshadowing a storming rampage. Pursued through the cityscape by ghostlike figures, a beehive of criminals rickrolled into action, she accepts her fate with defiant spirit. Amidst the ongoing tension, she performs a crucial logoff, narrowly escaping a belligerent confrontation. Now, a skydiver, she deambulates towards a tiny pinpoint of warmth, watching the snowfleck fall. The jurassic blunder of the past yields to a new kismet, a world of awe and mint glamour. A midwife with a sackful of onions sees the future unfold.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls

scenes.sentence: In the derelict factory, a loyal mechanic sifts through paperwork, sensing an impending storm.
scenes.prompt: Wide establishing shot of a massive, derelict factory, its smokestacks chuffing a harsh, morphic haze into a twilight sky. A rockery garden with a dry fountain stands neglected in the foreground. Inside, a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, sifts through stacks of paperwork, a modicum of loyalty to the old ways despite the underworld's enticement. She hears a distant blast, signaling an overplay of the local vagary, hinting at an impending rampage. The air is storming with unseen forces.

scenes.sentence: Through the neon city, she evades ghostlike figures, a defiant target of orchestrated criminals.
scenes.prompt: Medium shot of the teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, running across a high-contrast cityscape, the neon opacity of advertisements reflecting off wet pavement. She's pursued by ghostlike figures in calpacks, their presence an ongoing, catchy threat. A muzhiks gang, like a disturbed beehive, has been rickrolled into action by criminals. She accepts her fate, but with a wonderful defiance, giving a dismissive thumbs up after being slapped, refusing to be lynched or offsaddle her determination. Agterskots of the chase follow her.

scenes.sentence: Under pressure, she logs off, her secret message now on the internet, danger's kiss imminent.
scenes.prompt: Tight close-up of the teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, her face illuminated by the flickering light of a terminal. She's performing a logoff, having just managed to mention a critical detail on the internet after a hurried kaffeeklatsch. The tension is palpable, suspence heavy in the air. A belligerent dayworker, uppity with overstuffing, whines nearby, having just been given the brushoff. The air is thick with effluvial fumes from a recent defenestration. She feels a punctual kiss of danger, a whipjacks moment.

scenes.sentence: From the sky, she sees a transformed world, a new beginning of awe and warmth.
scenes.prompt: Overhead wide shot looking down on a landscape transformed, snowfleck covering tiny structures, like a jurassic, frozen expanse. The teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, now a skydiver, is deambulating towards a pinpoint of warmth. A midwife, with a sackful of onions, stands near dormant cannons, her gaze full of awe, acknowledging the kismet of this new glamour. The jawfall of the old world is a mere blunder, replaced by a fresh mint of possibility, free from ennui and the virgins of old. Gadzookery has given way to peace.
